name: Vercel Agent Harnesses
description: Runs Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Pi as durable harnesses whose turns resume after crashes or timeouts, for teams deploying coding agents on Vercel.

skills.name: Resume Interrupted Turns
skills.description: Keeps each session in a durable log so a new function resumes a turn after a crash, function timeout, or redeploy.

skills.name: Run Popular Harnesses
skills.description: Runs Pi and OpenCode in your function, and Claude Code and Codex experimentally in a Vercel Sandbox, keeping each harness's options and tools.

skills.name: Isolate Model Commands
skills.description: Runs commands and files the model picks in a virtual workspace or a Vercel Sandbox, never on the function's own disk.

skills.name: Self-Host On Any World
skills.description: Stores the session log in a Workflow SDK World: Vercel's on Vercel, files on your machine, or Postgres on your own servers.
